files.docs/caching.md:
# Caching

## Listing cache
Session listings are cached for 60 seconds: on the last enrolment day the old portal took about 40 requests per second on the listing, and every request hit the database.

## Profile cache
Candidate profiles come from the university directory, which is slow and allows only 10 requests per second, so profiles are kept for 24 hours.

events.message: feat(cache): cache session listings for 60 seconds
feat(seats): lock seat rows with SELECT FOR UPDATE

events.ref: chat 2026-03-11: switch seat locking to Postgres advisory locks

events.why: Row locks blocked listing reads during the enrolment-day load test; advisory locks keyed by session id leave the sessions table readable.

events.message: refactor(seats): route bookings through the advisory lock
docs: rewrite booking rules after seat locking change

files.docs/booking-rules.md:
# Booking rules

This replaces the March draft.

- A candidate books one seat per session.
- A seat is taken when the booking is confirmed; there is no 30-minute hold.
- Candidates can cancel their own booking up to 10 days before the exam.
- Bookings close 7 days before the exam.

events.message: feat(booking): cancel own booking before deadline

events.title: Fix double booking on payment retry
events.what: A candidate who retried a failed payment ended up with two confirmed seats in the same session.

events.message: fix(booking): apply each payment confirmation once
events.why: The gateway sends the same callback again on retry, so confirmations are keyed by the payment reference and applied only once.

files.docs/notifications.md:
# Notifications

## Receipts
Sent as soon as the gateway confirms a payment.

## Reminder timing
Exam-day reminders go out 48 hours before the exam, not 24: candidates must bring an ID and the printed booking reference, and in the pilot many asked for a working day to prepare.

events.why: The finance office requires every receipt to show the gateway transaction reference and the VAT-exemption note.

events.message: feat(mail): Italian and English receipt text

events.why: When the centre cancels a session, candidates must be told the same day and offered either a refund or a move to another date.

events.message: feat(sessions): cancelling a session sends notices
feat(cache): purge listing keys on session edit
events.why: Staff who moved a session to another room saw the old room on the listing for up to a minute, so edits now purge the listing keys at once.

events.message: test(cache): editing a session purges its listing
feat(reminders): crontab entry for daily reminders

files.ops/reminders.cron:
# Send exam-day reminders every morning at 07:30 Europe/Rome
CRON_TZ=Europe/Rome
30 7 * * * cd /srv/langcentre-exams && node src/reminders/cron-batch.js >> /var/log/reminders.log 2>&1

events.ref: chat 2026-04-20: run reminders from a jobs table polled by the app instead of system cron

steps.title: Reminder scheduling with a jobs table

events.why: The university hosting does not allow crontab on the app servers, so reminders are rows in a jobs table that the app polls.

events.message: feat(reminders): retry failed jobs with backoff
feat(reminders): enqueue reminder when a booking is paid

files.README.md:
# langcentre-exams

Exam booking portal for the University Language Centre.
Candidates browse exam sessions (CEFR A2-C1), book and pay for a seat.

## Staff exports
- Booking lists (CSV) and attendance sheets (PDF) per session
- Results file for the registry

events.ref: chat 2026-06-01: waitlist for full sessions, then seat offers to waitlisted candidates, then expiry of unanswered offers

files.src/waitlist/migration.sql:
CREATE TABLE waitlist (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id int NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),
  candidate_id int NOT NULL,
  joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (session_id, candidate_id)
);
